proposals.evidence: DEDR3045 explicitly gives Tamil/Malayalam taṇṇīr and shortened taṇṇi water, alongside taṇ cool;3690 gives nīr water. LSI dani Water is proposed as the corresponding reduced cool + water formation, with voiced initial d and a single undotted n retained. Ordered components express the historical compound; this is a qualified comparison, not an exact cited Irula spelling.
